proposal.reactor_type: 5 mL stainless-steel packed-bed reactor; unavailable for this hydrogenolysis because the installation is liquid-only and cannot receive hydrogen feed
proposal.residence_time_basis: Not applicable: no permitted hydrogen-containing inlet stream can be formed. A liquid-only residence time would not represent the required hydrogenolysis reaction.
proposal.light_setup: None; no light source is listed and photochemistry is not part of the specified hydrogenolysis.

streams.pump_role: HPLC pump; not to be operated for hydrogenolysis under blocked disposition
streams.contents: N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol in methanol; acetic acid is optional in the source protocol but no concentration or equivalents are specified

streams.pump_role: Hydrogen mass-flow controller — prohibited_unavailable; do not connect or operate

proposal.mixer_type: None assigned. The listed gas-liquid mixer is prohibited_unavailable, and no alternative gas-introduction hardware may be proposed.
proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Hydrogen would ordinarily need to be metered and mixed with the substrate solution before a catalyst-containing flow reactor. This required operation cannot be performed because hydrogen feed and the available gas-liquid mixer are prohibited.
pre_reactor_steps: Do not charge or connect hydrogen cylinders, hydrogen lines, the prohibited hydrogen mass-flow controller, or the prohibited gas-liquid mixer.
Do not charge Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 for an attempted liquid-only run, because it cannot perform the specified hydrogenolysis without hydrogen.

If work is resumed after facility authorization, perform a formal process-safety review and install/authorize compliant hydrogen delivery and gas-liquid contacting capability before defining operating conditions.
post_reactor_steps: No reaction effluent is generated under this blocked proposal.
Maintain the reactor isolated from any flammable-gas source and document the experiment as not run due to unavailable required reagent delivery.
proposal.chemistry_notes: The batch transformation is a Pd(OH)2/Al2O3-catalyzed hydrogenolysis of the N-diphenylmethyl group and explicitly requires hydrogen. Methanol, 60 °C, and optional acetic acid do not replace the need for hydrogen. The reported 38.1% batch yield does not provide sufficient kinetic, catalyst-loading, substrate-concentration, or hydrogen-uptake information to calculate a defensible flow residence time even if hydrogen hardware were available.
